test: full-frame blind gate, freshly randomized after diagnostic
single_ground_gap: The right lawn remains a uniformly fine, flat, grey-green granular surface, with no convincing directional blade clumps and associated relief through the near foreground. It reads as a texture laid on terrain; the left has tuft structure, varied blade direction, localized dark gaps and highlights.
other_scene_giveaway: The right image also has conspicuously sparse, repeated-looking tree foliage and exposed simplified background geometry. Those independently reveal it as rendered. The ground diagnosis does not depend on the sky.
accepted_scope: Larger approximately 20 ft lawn accepted; lawn extent was not used as a failure criterion.
independence_note: No source, individual reference, individual render or builder reports viewed. Per requested sequence, the focused pair was viewed and its key revealed before this separately randomized full-frame pair; the two verdicts are therefore not independent exposure experiments.
